$comment: v2.5 -> v2.6 (RC-13) moved the root `invites:` block to services/invite/config. Until v2.6 a file carried it at the root.

invites.comment: LEGACY (pre-v2.6). Relocated to the invite service config (services/invite/config) by relocate_invites_to_service; extract_invites_config reads both locations during rollout. Kept, like the domains defs, because the root additionalProperties is false and 30/47 production files still predate v2.5, so removing it would reject unmigrated files. Removal is gated on per-version schema validation (TODO.md).

invite.comment: LEGACY (pre-v2.6). The invite shape now lives in the invite service model (opi/services/catalog/invite/config_model.py) and its committed fragment invite.v1.0.json; this def only validates unmigrated top-level invites blocks.

i18n-text.comment: LEGACY (pre-v2.6). Used only by the legacy invite def; the current shape is I18nText in the invite service model.
